title: Pdi1 ribosome-binding residue library — evidence before 2026
objective: Identify individual residues contributing to Pdi1 ribosome association and distinguish this from productive RF/tRNA trapping, uptake and peptide instability.
coordinate_note: All positions use the supplied 20-residue mature Pdi1 sequence, identical to UniProt C0HKX8 (Apidaecin 1+). Api1b equivalents in the shared C-terminal segment are Pdi1 position minus 2. Each molecule is a linear all-L peptide (Gly achiral), free N-terminal amine and C-terminal carboxylic acid, no tags, no amidation. Assay labels are not part of this library.

sources.title: Apidaecin 1+ — Pimpla disparis (UniProtKB C0HKX8)
sources.coverage: UniProt REST JSON inspected for exact 20-residue mature sequence, species and original sequence publication PMID 7929322 (1994). Matches the user sequence exactly. Current database snapshot used for identity only; no later biological findings used.

regions.name: N-terminal segment
regions.description: Pdi1 residues 1–12. Variable across Api-like peptides; roles in uptake, exposure and tunnel association can overlap. Not declared dispensable for Pdi1.

regions.name: Tunnel-contact segment
regions.description: Pdi1 PRP segment, residues 13–15; contains the preliminarily binding-sensitive R14. Exact contacts have not been solved for Pdi1.

regions.name: Termination pharmacophore
regions.description: Pdi1 PHPRL segment, residues 16–20. RNA packing, RF recognition and the terminal carboxyl interaction are transferred from Api/Fva1 structures, not atomic observations in Pdi1.

hypotheses.question: Which residues of the C-terminal binding segment contribute to ribosome association, and which chiefly support termination-complex trapping?
hypotheses.mechanism: Eight separate alanine substitutions remove one side chain or proline constraint at a time. The terminal segment may combine RNA contacts, conformational positioning and RF/tRNA recognition.
hypotheses.measurement: Compare each mutant with WT in binding to mature E. coli 70S without RF/tRNA and to a defined post-release 70S–mRNA–deacyl-tRNA–RF complex; pair with toeprinting and RF retention. Loss of naked-70S binding supports an association contribution; selective loss on the complete complex supports context-dependent trapping.
hypotheses.note: Prespecified focused scan, not a claim that the remainder of Pdi1 is unimportant. R14A, P18A and R19A reproduce preliminary 2024 benchmarks. No predictions of numerical affinity.

hypotheses.question: Is removing an upstream arginine sufficient to reproduce the effect of the C-terminal arginine mutations?
hypotheses.mechanism: R7A removes the same nominal positive side-chain charge as R14A or R19A while retaining the entire C-terminal segment.
hypotheses.measurement: Compare R7A directly with R14A/R19A and WT in the same purified-ribosome binding assay, then compare peptide exposure and cellular activity.
hypotheses.note: This is a positional charge control; it is not guaranteed binding-neutral and does not isolate guanidinium chemistry from charge.

series.coverage: Complete alanine scan of PRPPHPRL, Pdi1 positions 13–20. No omissions. Positions 1–12 are outside this series; R7A is a separate upstream control. Three positions already have preliminary Pdi1 residue-level evidence and are deliberate replications.

attempted_analyses.reason: UniRef50_C0HKX8 contains only 3 UniProtKB sequences, below the fetcher floor of 30; C0HKX8 has no Pfam family for fallback. No meaningful computed residue-conservation profile was produced.
attempted_analyses.attempted: Ran bundled fetch_homologs.py C0HKX8 research/conservation. Reference verified as 20 aa, Pimpla disparis. Fetcher exit 2. No aligner ran because the comparison set was refused; no hand-selected or designed-sequence conservation substituted.

precedent_search.scope: Completed before candidate selection: separate primary-research searches for Pdi1/Pimpla disparis binding, ribosome kinetics and alanine substitutions; apidaecin RF/tRNA contacts, sequence–activity work and 2024–2025 assembly/proline-geometry papers. Browsing checked relevant references linked by central 2024 and 2021 papers plus newer citing primary work. Literature cutoff strictly before 2026-01-01. Post-cutoff search hits were excluded from the design evidence.
